cues.zh: 我们一直致力于开发这款键盘，
cues.en: Our continuous efforts to develop the keyboard have

cues.zh: 始终聚焦于表面层面的问题。
cues.en: always focused on surface level problems.

cues.zh: 但如果我们需要一款别出心裁的键盘，一款能把问题空间彻底翻转过来的键盘呢？
cues.en: But what if we need a keyboard with a twist, one that turns the problem space outside-in.

cues.zh: 隆重推出 Gboard 双面版，一款正反面无缝连接的键盘。
cues.en: Introducing the Gboard Double-Sided Version, a keyboard where the front and back are seamlessly connected.

cues.zh: 这款键盘由 26 个模块连接而成，每个模块包含 8 个键轴，
cues.en: This keyboard is made by connecting 26 modules, each containing 8 key switches,

cues.zh: 再以特殊方式扭转，形成没有正反面之分的双面设计。
cues.en: then twisting them in a way that creates a double sided design with no front or back.

cues.zh: 我们也非常注重表面贴装工艺。
cues.en: We also paid close attention to the surface mounting.

cues.zh: 我们还实现了灯效。
cues.en: We also implemented lighting effects.

cues.zh: 让表面负载更加炫酷。
cues.en: They make the surface loads flashier.

cues.zh: 键盘和我，经历过起起落落。但这一款？
cues.en: Keyboards and I, we've had our ups and downs. But this one?

cues.zh: 这一款不一样。它简直像是为前端开发量身打造的。
cues.en: This one's different. It's like it was made for front-end development.

cues.zh: 键盘的设计让按键和快捷键紧密联动，让我的表格工作流畅多了。
cues.en: The keyboard's design creates a tight loop between keys and shortcuts, making my spreadsheet work flow much more smoothly.

cues.zh: 我出门在外时，它舒适地挂在手腕上。完美！
cues.en: It hangs comfortably on my wrist while I'm out and about. Perfect!

cues.zh: 我没想到一切都这么直观显眼！这比我预想的方便多了。
cues.en: I didn't realize everything would be so front and center! This is way more convenient than I expected.

cues.zh: Gboard 双面版适用于多种应用场景。
cues.en: The Gboard Double-Sided Version is suitable for a variety of applications.

cues.zh: 从各个角度去攻克你的编程问题。
cues.en: Approach your coding problems from all sides.

cues.zh: 把它用到地球之外去。
cues.en: Use it off the face of the planet.

cues.zh: 不只是打字，
cues.en: Beyond typing,

cues.zh: 还能让它化身节日花环，带来节日气氛。
cues.en: let it bring out the holiday spirit as a festive wreath.

cues.zh: 招待客人时，展现你最好的一面。
cues.en: Put your best face forward when entertaining guests.

cues.zh: 纸质版也在开发中。
cues.en: A paper version is also in development.

cues.zh: 用剪刀简单一剪，就露出一个大环，这是你通往拓扑学奇妙世界的入口。
cues.en: A simple snip of the scissors reveals a large loop, your gateway to the wonders of topology.

cues.zh: 未来的更新可能加入传送门功能，开启一个全新的维度。
cues.en: Future updates might include a portal feature, giving access to a whole new dimension.

cues.zh: 也许你会发现一个此前未知的自己。
cues.en: Maybe you'll find a hitherto unknown side to yourself.

cues.zh: 可能性是无限的。
cues.en: The possibilities are infinite.

cues.zh: Gboard 双面版：打字的新维度。
cues.en: Gboard Double-Sided Version: A new dimension in typing.

cues.zh: 在我们持续开发键盘的过程中
cues.en: In our continuous efforts to develop the keyboard

cues.zh: 我们从未充分关注底层问题。
cues.en: we never paid enough attention to the underlying issues.

cues.zh: 但假如我们需要一款别出心裁的键盘，一款能把问题空间彻底翻转的键盘呢。
cues.en: But what if we need a keyboard with a twist, one that turns the problem space inside-out.

cues.zh: 隆重推出 Gboard 双面版，一款正反面无缝相连的键盘。
cues.en: Introducing the Gboard Double-Sided Version, a keyboard where the back and front are seamlessly connected.

cues.zh: 这款键盘由 26 个模块连接而成，每个模块包含 8 个按键开关，
cues.en: This keyboard is made by connecting 26 modules, each containing 8 key switches,

cues.zh: 然后将它们扭转，形成一种没有正反面之分的双面设计。
cues.en: then twisting them in a way that creates a double sided design with no front or back.

cues.zh: 我们注重细节，连电路板的背面也不例外。
cues.en: We paid close attention to detail, even on the back of the circuit board.

cues.zh: 我们还实现了灯光效果。
cues.en: We also implemented lighting effects.

cues.zh: 它确实给背景增添了鲜活的点缀。
cues.en: It really adds a vibrant pop to the background.

cues.zh: 以前我不小心把键盘翻过来、在背面打字时，总会很抓狂，
cues.en: I used to get frustrated when I'd accidentally flip my keyboard and type on the back,

cues.zh: 但有了这款键盘，这就不再是问题了！它简直是为后端开发量身打造的。
cues.en: but with this keyboard, that's no longer a problem! It's perfect for back-end development.

cues.zh: 多亏了这款键盘，我感觉自己成了搜索专家圈子里的一员！
cues.en: Thanks to this keyboard, I feel like I'm part of the in-crowd of search specialists!

cues.zh: 它挂在肩上携带超方便，我爱死它了！
cues.en: It's so easy to carry around on my shoulder, I love it!

cues.zh: 它方便到你会成为所有人羡慕的对象！
cues.en: It's so convenient that you'll be the in-vy of everybody!

cues.zh: Gboard 双面版适用于各种场景。
cues.en: The Gboard Double-Sided Version is suitable for a variety of applications.

cues.zh: 一起享受 mob programming 吧。
cues.en: Enjoy mob programming together.

cues.zh: 它甚至在外太空也能用。
cues.en: It's usable even in outer space.

cues.zh: 除了打字，
cues.en: Beyond typing,

cues.zh: 还能把它当作时尚的节日花环来迎接新年，
cues.en: ring in the new year by using it as a stylish holiday wreath

cues.zh: 或者用它来探索新的占卜方式。
cues.en: or use it to discover new forms of divination.

cues.zh: 纸质版也在开发中。
cues.en: A paper version is also under development.

cues.zh: 让三叶结带你踏上拓扑学奇妙世界的旅程。
cues.en: Let the Trefoil Knot be your guide on a journey through the fascinating world of topology.

cues.zh: 维度传送门功能已列入我们的路线图
cues.en: A dimensional portal feature is on our roadmap

cues.zh: 但细节尚属机密。
cues.en: but the details are classified.

cues.zh: 可能性超越无限！
cues.en: The possibilities are beyond infinite!

cues.zh: Gboard 双面版：打字新维度。
cues.en: Gboard Double-Sided Version: A new dimension in typing.
